questions: Does the wider sensor spread reduce line loss events effectively?
Is the control effort improved with this geometry?
Are max and RMS errors reduced with the new sensor placement?
Does steering oscillation decrease with the chosen wheel track and sensor layout?
Is noise robustness maintained or improved with this sensor configuration?

intent: The geometry uses a symmetric sensor array with wider outer sensors placed near the front corners to improve curve detection and reduce line loss events. The body dimensions are chosen near the upper bounds for stability and space to accommodate sensors and wheels. The wheel track and radius are set to provide good maneuverability and stability. The mass is moderate to balance inertia and control effort.
